text: Laaɓalam reedu e waaju am nafataa on, si tawii Alla no faandii majjingol on e laawol focciingol ngol, o woɗɗina on e peewal ngal sabu ƴaggere mon nden. Ko Kanko woni Joomi mon, ko Kanko anndi fii mon: Himo majjina on si O muuyii, ko ka Makko tun woni ruttorde mon Ñalnde Darngal, O yoɓita on njoɓdi golle mon.
